examples.en: The rule is in black and white.

meaning.en: In black and white means in written or printed form, rather than communicated only through speech. It often emphasises that information, a promise, a rule or an agreement has been recorded and can therefore be checked later. Cambridge defines the expression as “in writing”, while Collins explains that the information has been written or printed rather than merely said.
meaning.zh: In black and white 表示某項資料、承諾、規則或協議已經以書面或印刷形式記錄下來，而不只是口頭說明。它通常強調有一份可以日後查閱、核實或作為證據的文字記錄。

register.summaryEn: everyday conversation; workplace communication; customer-service situations; school communication; news and reports; discussions about contracts and agreements.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬於中性語域，可以自然地用於日常對話、工作溝通、顧客服務、學校通告、新聞報道， 以及有關合約和協議的討論。

register.formalEn: Use the idiom only in the contexts described in the source.
register.formalZh: 只在原檔說明的合適情境中使用這個慣用語。

examples.en: The conditions were written in black and white.

examples.en: His support was recorded in black and white.

examples.en: The contract says, in black and white, that the deposit cannot be returned.

specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Once / when / before / until / unless + subject + be + in black and white。

examples.zh: 職責白紙黑字列明後，每個人都會知道應做甚麼。

examples.en: I will not agree until the terms are in black and white.

examples.en: Unless the promise is in black and white, do not pay.

examples.en: Having the costs in black and white makes comparison easier.
examples.zh: 把費用白紙黑字列出來，會更容易作出比較。

specificForms.titleEn: At Different Positions in the Sentence
specificForms.descriptionEn: The target does not have to occupy the same position in every answer.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 目標表達不必在每個答案中都出現在相同位置。

examples.en: The price and payment date are in black and white in the contract.
examples.zh: 價錢和付款日期已在合約中白紙黑字列明。

benefits.titleEn: It Distinguishes Written Evidence from Spoken Words
benefits.titleZh: 區分書面證據與口頭說法
benefits.en: The idiomatic version emphasises that a spoken statement is not enough.
benefits.zh: 我們希望經理把承諾白紙黑字寫下來。 這個版本強調單憑口頭說法並不足夠。

examples.en: We want the manager’s promise in black and white.
examples.zh: 我們希望經理把承諾白紙黑字寫下來。

benefits.titleEn: It Expresses a Request for Certainty
benefits.en: This clearly tells the listener that the speaker wants a permanent record that can be checked later.
benefits.zh: 我需要新條件的書面確認。 這句話清楚表示說話者想要一份可以日後查閱的永久記錄。

examples.en: I need the new conditions in black and white.
examples.zh: 我需要新條件的書面確認。

benefits.titleEn: It Helps Point to Documentary Evidence
benefits.en: This is a concise and natural response when somebody denies or questions something already recorded in a document.
benefits.zh: 那裏已白紙黑字寫明。 當有人否認或質疑文件中已有記錄的事情時，這是一個簡潔自然的回應。

examples.en: There it is in black and white.
examples.zh: 那裏已白紙黑字寫明。

benefits.en: The expression is useful when several people need one shared written version of an arrangement.
benefits.zh: 讓我們把最終計劃白紙黑字寫下來。 當多人需要一份共同認可的書面安排時，這個表達十分實用。

examples.en: Let’s put the final plan in black and white.
examples.zh: 讓我們把最終計劃白紙黑字寫下來。

benefits.titleEn: It Works in Many Grammar Shells
benefits.en: Students can therefore practise the same fixed expression without repeating one mechanically identical sentence pattern.
benefits.zh: 因此，學生可以反覆練習同一個固定表達，而不必機械地重複相同句式。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful but Not Automatically Better
benefits.titleZh: 實用，但不一定比普通說法更好
benefits.en: Use in black and white when the contrast between written and spoken information matters. For an ordinary action such as writing a shopping list, write it down is usually simpler and more natural.
benefits.zh: 只有當書面資料與口頭說法之間的分別是語境重點時，才適合使用 in black and white。 如果只是寫下一張普通購物清單，直接使用 write it down 通常更簡單自然。

origin.statusEn: Gradual Development; Early Written Uses Recorded
origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；有早期文字記錄

history.en: Merriam-Webster records black-and-white as a noun meaning writing or print from 1569. Etymonline reports the earlier reversed form in white-and-black from the 1590s and the now familiar expression be in black and white from the 1650s. These dates refer to surviving records, not necessarily the first time anybody used the expression.
history.zh: 記錄了 black-and-white 在1569年已有「文字或印刷品」的名詞意思。 Etymonline 指出，次序相反的 in white-and-black 在1590年代已有記錄，而今天較熟悉的 be in black and white 則在1650年代已有記錄。 這些日期只代表現存的早期文字記錄，不一定是首次有人使用這個表達的時間。

history.en: Because spoken words can be forgotten, denied or changed, information placed on paper came to represent something recorded and available for checking.
history.zh: 由於口頭說話可能被忘記、否認或改變，寫在紙上的內容逐漸代表一份可以日後查閱的記錄。

origin.memoryEn: Black letters on white paper create a record that can be seen again.
origin.memoryZh: 白紙上的黑字形成一份可以再次查閱的記錄。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：只教授書面記錄的意思

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Monochrome Pictures
rules.titleZh: 規則二：不可用來表示黑白影像
rules.en: This is a literal photography or film meaning, not the target meaning.
rules.zh: 這裏表示電影只有黑、白和灰色，屬於影像的字面意思，並不是本課教授的書面記錄意思。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with “See Things in Black and White”
rules.en: He sees only two opposite possibilities and ignores more complex possibilities. This is not the target sense.
rules.zh: 不可與 see things in black and white 混淆意思： 這並不是本練習的目標意思。

rules.titleEn: Written Does Not Automatically Mean True
rules.titleZh: 規則四：寫下來不等於必然正確
rules.en: A false claim can also appear in writing. The idiom means that the information is recorded, not that its accuracy has been independently proved.
rules.zh: 一個錯誤說法也可以被寫進文件。 這個慣用語表示資料已有書面記錄，並不代表內容已經過獨立證實。

rules.titleEn: Written Does Not Automatically Mean Legally Binding
rules.titleZh: 規則五：書面記錄不一定具有法律約束力
rules.en: A casual email may place a promise in writing, but whether it forms a legally enforceable agreement is a separate legal question.
rules.zh: 一封普通電郵可以把承諾寫下來，但它是否構成具有法律約束力的協議，屬於另一個法律問題。

rules.titleZh: 規則六：保留時態及情態
rules.en: Do not turn may be recorded into is recorded.
rules.zh: 不可把「可能會記錄」改成「已經記錄」。

rules.titleZh: 規則七：保留肯定及否定意思

rules.titleEn: Keep the Document or Context When It Matters
rules.titleZh: 規則八：在有需要時保留文件或情境
rules.en: If the source identifies a contract, email, notice, receipt or report, the answer should normally preserve that context.
rules.zh: 如果原句指出資料位於合約、電郵、告示、收據或報告中，答案通常應保留該文件資料。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the Same Meaning
rules.titleZh: 規則九：不要重複相同意思
rules.en: The second clause repeats the meaning already expressed by the idiom.
rules.zh: 重複的中文意思： 規則已在手冊中白紙黑字列明。

examples.en: The rule is in black and white in the handbook.
examples.zh: 規則已在手冊中白紙黑字列明。

rules.titleEn: Use It Naturally, Not for Every Written Item
rules.titleZh: 規則十：自然使用，不要套用於所有文字
rules.en: confirmation; evidence; clarity; protection against later denial; a record of an agreement or condition.
rules.zh: 如果只是在說某人寫了一篇普通文章，而書面記錄並不是語境重點，直接使用 write 可能更加自然。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using in black and white.
instructions.zh: 使用 in black and white 改寫句子或完成回應。
